label: INFERENCE
extraction: LangGraph: represents agent reasoning as Directed Acyclic Graph for deterministic flows. Dominant framework for implementing state-aware hierarchical loops (orchestrator-subagent pattern). Supports supervisor/worker architectures, parallel execution, state persistence, human-in-the-loop. Google ADK, Microsoft Agent Framework, and OpenAI Agents SDK all support this pattern natively as of 2026. Key concept: graph-based orchestration with explicit state management, enabling complex multi-agent workflows with clear handoffs and checkpointing. Enables deterministic multi-agent orchestration through explicit graph structure.
